name: messenger-mcp
description: Messenger (messaging): me, list_inbound, get_thread, send, mark_read. Every tool maps to a documente

platform_mcp_messenger_page_access_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_MESSENGER_PAGE_ACCESS_TOKEN
platform_mcp_messenger_page_access_token.description: Page access token requested by a person who can perform the MESSAGING (or MODERATE) task on the Page, with pages_messaging, pages_manage_metadata and pages_read_engagement (https://developers.facebook.com/docs/messenger-platform/conversations); sent as `Authorization: Bearer`.

platform_mcp_messenger_page_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_MESSENGER_PAGE_ID
platform_mcp_messenger_page_id.description: Numeric id of the Facebook Page whose Messenger inbox is used; every call goes to /<page_id>/... Env: PLATFORM_MCP_MESSENGER_PAGE_ID.

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /{page_id}?fields=id,name,link: the Page that sends and receives Messenger messages.

tools.name: list_inbound
tools.description: GET /{page_id}/conversations?platform=messenger with field expansion messages.limit(1){...}: one row per conversation carrying its most recent message (which may be the Page's own outbound message - compare from_id with the Page / account id). thread_id is the conversation id for get_thread; from_id is the PSID for send. 'Conversations that are within the Requests folder that have not been active for 30 days will not be returned'. `since`/`channel` are not sent; cursor paging, so `page` is ignored.

tools.name: get_thread
tools.description: GET /{conversation_id}/messages?fields=id,message,from,to,created_time (newest first). 'you can only get details about the 20 most recent messages in the conversation' (https://developers.facebook.com/docs/messenger-platform/conversations), so limit is capped at 20.

tools.name: send
tools.description: POST /{page_id}/messages {recipient: {id: PSID}, messaging_type: RESPONSE, message: {text}} answers {recipient_id, message_id}. `to` must be a Page-scoped ID (list_inbound from_id); 'the conversation must be initiated by that person' and RESPONSE messages 'must be sent during the standard messaging window' (24 hours after the person's last message). `subject`/`channel` are ignored.

tools.name: mark_read
tools.description: Sender action mark_seen: POST /{page_id}/messages {recipient: {id}, sender_action: mark_seen} answers {recipient_id}. Here `thread_id` must be the person's PSID (list_inbound from_id), NOT the conversation id; `message_id` is not used. 'Requests to display sender action should only include the sender_action parameter and the recipient object.'
